newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher as futures chase cash.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher as futures chase cash.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher as the futures market attempted to catch up with cash markets, traders said.
"Futures are converging to cash. Also people are positioning themselves for business," a trader said.
Traders said the rally was quiet and the speculative element remained poised to sell significant rallies.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 500 contracts, up from 492 Thursday.
Rice futures closed four to six cents per cwt higher, with November up six at $9.94.
